rubrics.description: The response should precisely follow all explicit formatting and structural instructions provided in the user's prompt.
The response should convey the required information using the minimum number of words, avoiding any unnecessary text that does not add informational value.
The response should output exactly the requested content and format without any additional text, explanation, or commentary.
The response should include conventional politeness elements appropriate to the context, such as gratitude expressions, polite requests, or assumption declarations in uncertain situations.
The response should present the requested information immediately as its primary content, without preamble, conversational framing, or unsolicited additional information.
